newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Yeltsin says relations with Iran good.
newsitem.headline: Yeltsin says relations with Iran good.

text.p: Russian President Boris Yeltsin said on Friday that his country enjoyed good relations with Iran as Western nations distanced themselves from Tehran after a German court ruled that Iran ordered the 1992 murders of Kurdish activists in Berlin.

"We have good, positive cooperation with Iran, which shows a tendency to grow," Interfax news agency quoted Yeltsin as saying during talks in the Kremlin with Ali Akbar Nateq-Nouri, the head of the Iranian parliament.
